name: rooms
rule: at most 16 roles per set, every role a name in data/palette.json roles, ids unique, append only
notes: A set is a list of role names, not colour numbers, so a colour may be moved in data/palette.json and every room follows.
A room's cap is 16 because spec 13 caps the screen at 16 colours. The checker counts the roles and refuses a 17th.
ui is the default set for a screen that has not named one, so drawing before a map loads still asks for a real colour.

sets.note: panels, text and the cursor: the window frame, its shadow, ink on paper
the small ship deck in daylight: bronze hull, sea and gold fittings
the cabin off the deck: a lamp, a bunk and the bronze hull, warmer and narrower than the deck
the Navy lower deck: darker bronze, sea light through the hatch, wine trim
the Town Quay at night: wet stone, black water, two gold lamps and the brick of the sheds
the dock office: one lamp, a ledger, a counter and the door, warmer than the quay outside
the night drive: tarmac, lane paint, the chalk-lit verge, the sodium lamp and the barrier steel
